title: Navigate a module tree
summary: Use crate-root and parent-relative paths while making nested items accessible to callers.

export.clue: Visibility keyword allowing a caller outside math to call bump

unsigned.clue: Unsigned 32-bit type of the bump parameter

nested.clue: Keyword declaring the nested batches module

parent.clue: Path prefix reaching the enclosing math module from batches

root.clue: Path prefix reaching the root-level BASE constant regardless of module nesting

function.clue: Keyword defining the executable entry function

equal.clue: Macro checking the nested module’s computed result

separator.clue: Separator between module and function names in a path
